exact_statement: Fix C>=0 and a prescribed complete finite fair physical tree T for a Boolean core g, with constant leaves, and let q=Q_C(g,T) be the least nonnegative reserve satisfying D<=Cd+Q-EQ_child. For F_L=g(product of L fresh inputs in each block), a physical compression tree retaining one input per block followed by consistently sign-translated copies of T has Q_C at a node with ell_i surviving inputs equal to [q-C sum_i(ell_i-1)Inf_i(g)]_+. In particular its root reserve is [q-C(L-1)I(g)]_+. Spectator parity of m fresh inputs has root reserve [q-Cm]_+. Whole-block simulation of T instead has Q_C(F_L)=Q_(LC)(g,T), which is at least the compression-first reserve. For ordinary addressing A_a and data-first T, at C=4,L=2, compression-first reserve is0 whereas block-data-first reserve is at least [a-8]_+; both complete trees can be extended without reserve change to the same singleton physical leaf partition and have Pi_H=2a,Pi_I=a+2. Thus their reserve gap is unbounded although total paid debt is identical and root H/I<2. On a general zero-entropy plateau with terminal nonnegative reserve q_l and total path influence b_l, [E q_l-C E b_l]_+<=Q_root<=E[q_l-Cb_l]_+. No universal FEI or initial reserve bound is asserted.
hypotheses: Uniform finite physical cubes, Boolean sign outputs and entropy in bits
C>=0,L integer>=2,m integer>=0; constant leaves for the prescribed core continuation
Compression never exhausts a block and its core continuation is consistently input/output-sign translated
Whole-block simulation queries all inputs in the block corresponding to the seed query before its next query
The general plateau bound assumes exactly zero entropy decrements, nonnegative path influences and nonnegative terminal reserve values
